description: Korean coding font pairing Monaspace Neon with Pretendard (14 styles)
pre_install: if ($global) { throw 'Only per-user installation is supported. Do not use -g.' }
if ([Environment]::OSVersion.Version.Build -lt 17763) { throw 'Windows 10 1809 or later is required.' }

if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fontDir $font.Name)) { throw 'Existing manual font installation detected. Close applications, uninstall the ZIP-installed family, then retry Scoop. No files were overwritten.' }

script: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Font installation failed. Close applications using the font and retry; inspect the error above.' }

pre_uninstall: } catch { throw ('Cannot remove fonts in use. Close editors and terminals using Monatendard, then retry. Registration has not been removed. Details: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }

script: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Font removal failed. Close applications using the font and retry; inspect the error above.' }

notes: Restart editors and terminals, then select Monatendard. Close applications using this family before updating or uninstalling.
